name: spartan-web
description: Real, vscode.dev-inspired web app for Spartan IDE (§75.85/§75.89, task #81) -- concepts only, zero VS Code/vscode.dev code. Client-side half of the hybrid architecture: real File System Access API file editing backed by the real spartan-buffer engine compiled to WASM (crates/spartan-buffer-wasm). LSP/DAP/Leo connectivity via spartan-backend's real WebSocket transport (§75.88) is not wired yet -- see README.md.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p spartan-buffer-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/spartan_buffer_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir src/wasm-gen
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
